gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all issue type schemes to understand the available configurations for my projects.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all issue type schemes with their details, including IDs and names.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new issue type scheme so that I can customize issue types for specific projects.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the scheme details and return the created issue type scheme with its ID.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to get the mapping of issue type schemes to projects to ensure proper issue categorization.
gold.ideal: The API should return a mapping of issue type schemes to their respective projects.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to find out which issue type scheme is assigned to my project to manage issues effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return the issue type scheme assigned to the specified project.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to assign an issue type scheme to a project to ensure it uses the correct issue types.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a project ID and an issue type scheme ID, and confirm the assignment.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to delete an issue type scheme that is no longer needed to keep the system clean.
gold.ideal: The API should delete the specified issue type scheme and return a success message.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update an existing issue type scheme to reflect changes in project requirements.
gold.ideal: The API should accept updated details for the issue type scheme and return the updated scheme.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to add new issue types to an existing issue type scheme to expand its functionality.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a list of issue type IDs to add and return the updated issue type scheme.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to reorder issue types in an issue type scheme to prioritize certain types for my team.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a new order for the issue types and return the updated scheme.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to remove an issue type from an issue type scheme that is no longer relevant.
gold.ideal: The API should delete the specified issue type from the scheme and confirm the removal.
